text:
zara: FYI I opened a draft PR to add a short 'warm pool' pattern to Dedicated provisioning docs + a small preemption retry pattern for the SDK. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612
leo: Nice. Can you summarise the warm-pool idea here? Want to make sure it's not confused with reserved pools.
zara: Sure  Warm pool = lightweight always-on instances that hold KV caches and a minimal model variant to reduce cold-starts for bursts. Not billed like full reserved pools; meant as a latency optimization for bursty endpoints. I added config samples and a short ops note about billing implications.
emily: Ill review the SDK snippet. Can you include an explicit PreemptedError example and a short jittered backoff retry? Customers ask for that pattern often.
zara: Yup, included a Python snippet showing client.errors.PreemptedError handling and fallback to a smaller variant + exponential sleep.
sam: Dropping a suggested YAML warm-pool sample to keep parity with existing naming conventions:
```yaml
warm_pool:
  name: bursts-warm
  size: 2-small-gpu
  cache_ttl: 10m
  prefetch_models:
    - gptx-8q
  billing_tier: warm
  failover:
    fallback_route: shared-hosted
```
sam: Also added an ops note: "Warm pools do not guarantee SLA; use reserved pools for SLA-backed routes."
docs-ci: docs-ci started for PR #612  running lint + spellcheck
docs-ci: lint error  docs/dedicated/provisioning.md line 73 (code fence style). Please use fenced triple-backtick blocks.
zara: Thanks CI. I'll fix the fences and push a follow-up.
leo: On SLA wording  we should be explicit about metrics. Suggest: "SLA-backed routes: 99.9% availability; p95 latency <= 250ms under normal load. Best-effort routes: no availability guarantee and subject to preemption during capacity pressure." Add a short example mapping table?
zemily: (typo, emily) I like the mapping idea. Short table with three rows: reserved pool (SLA+fallback), warm pool (latency-optimized, best-effort), hosted fallback (no SLA).
emily: I left a small inline about anchor naming in the PR comments.
sam: One more ops preference: prefer 5m autoscale window for warm/bursty endpoints and 20m for steady high-throughput endpoints. I added a recommendation paragraph.
zara: Good call. I also added a migration callout for customers moving from Dedicated to Private: they must update KMS policies and add Private control-plane CIDRs to egress allowlist. The callout links to a stubbed migration guide.
leo: Can we add an example terraform snippet in docs later? Maybe separate follow-up.
zara: Yes, planning a follow-up TF mini-PR after this merges.
docs-ci: build queued... :hourglass:
docs-ci: build succeeded  all checks passed :tada:
ops-bot: FYI ops consulted: warm pools will be chargeable under a new 'warm' billing tier; billing docs PR will follow.
emily: Reviewing SDK snippet now. One tiny nit: use client.reserve_pool(...) vs client.create_pool in our SDK examples for new API naming.
zara: Updated snippet and pushed.
leo: LGTM. Approving PR.
emily: Approved with wording tweak.
sam: Looks good to me too.
zara: Thanks all  merging after final CI. Will open TF follow-up for examples and a CLI quickstart. :shipit:
